entradas.text: Lucian held the door for me and we both left the office for the White Room.
One by one, my ministers packed up and left the White Room.
The last two and a half years had gone by so fast.
I stared at the secret phone in my office and thought about what Remus Holstron had told me.
I wasn't sure if using Karl to go against the Old Guard was a sound choice. I wondered if he could be trusted.
Maybe this was the time to take advantage of my cooperation with the Young Sords.
I called the number Remus gave me.
But I decided against it.
Maybe this was the time to take advantage of my cooperation with the Young Sords again.
Gus, however, stayed behind.
I left the White Room and headed to my office.
I followed suit and headed to my office.
“In a few years the vineyard may even challenge its regional rivals. But it would need some further attention to rank among Sordland's best.”
“FC Anrica has seen a boost in ticket sales following your endorsement and participation in the club. The management decided to send over a slice of that pie.”
“The management of Underhall has decided to send big bonuses to the board after high revenue growth this quarter.”
“Several construction projects have been accomplished around the country. The company coffers are full and we stand to benefit.”
“Your vineyard in Erlory has begun producing some wine. I have also arranged for several tasting sessions in order to sample the product and give ideas on how to improve the quality.”
“The manager personally thanked you for the support you have shown the team. Several players have already decided to join the USP.”
“Since its successful contract win, the company has received and accepted numerous several mega-projects in other countries. Underhall's future is looking bright.”
"Mr. President. Just a quick word regarding the investment I arranged for you."
“The money should be arriving in your account shortly.”
“The manager personally thanked you for the support you have shown and wanted me to relay that he is no fan of Mayor Leste either.”
"That's great news, Gus."
"Rayne Wines. I can't wait."
"What did I tell you, Mr. President? Take a little risk and it'll pay off in the end."
"So awarding Underhall a government contract caused me to benefit personally. That doesn't sound entirely above-board."
"Always, Mr. President."
"Don't worry. Nobody else needs to know about this."
"Is the team winning?"
"FC Anrica? Actually, they've been playing a lot better than in recent years. You should check out a match sometime."
"Are your investments doing well too?"
"It's a pleasure doing business with you. And Ewald sends his greetings."
"And they're happy to receive that support. Truly a two-way street."
"It's a pleasure doing business with you."
"I look forward to opening the first bottle with you."
"I'm just happy to support Sordish businesses."
